newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-INDIA NAME TWO UNCAPPED PLAYERS FOR S.AFRICA TOUR.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA NAME TWO UNCAPPED PLAYERS FOR S.AFRICA TOUR.

text.p: Indian selectors on Tuesday retained Sachin Tendulkar as captain and named two uncapped players in a 16-man squad for their tour of South Africa starting on December 19.
Jagmohan Dalmiya, secretary of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), said Tendulkar would lead India on the tours to South Africa, Zimbabwe and the West Indies.
Wicket-keeper Saba Karim, who toured the West Indies with India in 1988-89, and medium-pacer Doddanarasiah Ganesh, were the only uncapped players included in the squad.
Wicketkeeper-batsman Pankaj Dharmani was chosen a specialist batsman.

Opener Vikram Rathore and left-arm spinner Venkatapathy Raju have been recalled, while left-arm spinner Sunil Joshi and off-spinner Aashish Kapoor -- both playing in the current test against South Africa at Kanpur -- have been omitted.
India are scheduled to play three tests against South Africa and compete in a triangular series which will also involve Zimbabwe.

At the end of the South African tour on February 12, India will play two one-day internationals against Zimbabwe before proceeding to the West Indies, where they are scheduled to play five tests and four one-dayers.
Dalmiya said some changes may be made to the squad after the three tests in South Africa.

Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Anil Kumble (vice-captain), Woorkeri Raman, Vikram Rathore, Saurav Ganguly, Mohammed Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, Vangipurappu Laxman, Pankaj Dharmani, Nayan Mongia, Saba Karim, Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad, David Johnson, Doddanarasiah Ganesh and Venkatapathy Raju.
